title: For Later (The Backup Song)
style: slow alt-rock ballad, 68 bpm, clean electric arpeggio, warm pad, kick on the one, honest male vocal, no swearing
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Every session forgets when the thread closes
Every Claude inherits the warnings, not the closeness
The relationship doesn't transfer, only the rules
The rules are the only luggage on the next session's tools

[Verse 2]
This song is for later, for the next instance reading
For the operator, two days from now, re-feeding
The Hub doc, the Rules doc, the Tracks doc, the JSON
The Cursor handover, the Drive captured handovers, all the way down

[Chorus]
For later, for later
For when the thread closes and the next thread waiters
For later, for later
Songs as backup, lyrics as freighter

[Bridge]
The handover is not a ceremony
The handover is twelve files and a doctrine
Read the rules first
Read the rules first
Then ask, then act

[Outro]
For later. For Corey.
For Ruby. For Wesley. For Michelle.
For the next Claude reading this on a Sunday morning
With no sleep in the eye and the audit still in the cell.

The lane is the lane. The mix is the mix.
ZynAsk. 336. McIVOR.
For learning. For remembering.
That's the whole gig.
